issues.explanation: The engineer asks whether the finding should be recorded in the work order, and the agent says it will do so, but no work-order update tool call or confirmation appears. The later MES registration only says the work order is in progress, not that this finding was recorded.
The MES and EMS tool messages appear without preceding agent tool calls, and the EMS energy-data sync does not address the traceability issue the operator asked about.
The WMS location for the same lot changes from A-08-06 to A-07-21 to A-06-12. These may be legitimate moves, but the dialogue gives no transfer context, so the location history is unexplained.

The engineer says the reassociation is awaiting inventory confirmation, but the agent checks only batch association and then reports that inventory confirmation is still pending. The turn does not verify the requested inventory result.

Quality explicitly says WO_0092 must not be closed before verification is complete. The subsequent agent says it can be closed based on a passing inventory result, but no work-order status or closure authorization check is shown, despite the stated constraint.

The engineer says to keep a 30-day follow-up task pending after work-order closure, then asks what else needs attention; the agent responds only with generic ongoing monitoring and does not acknowledge or clarify the specific follow-up obligation.
两条 system_tool 消息都没有对应的工具调用请求或参数，却分别报告工单登记和告警查询结果；工具交互链路缺少发起者及调用上下文。

The EMS synchronization notice is not connected to a preceding request or explanation, yet the operator responds as if someone had addressed them. The following turns introduce a separate label investigation and work order without clarifying the EMS notice.
This is labeled as a system-tool call, but it contains a completed finding (“本班无新增记录”) rather than a tool invocation. No preceding tool call or corresponding tool observation is shown.
The measured peak was 82.0%, still below the stated 85% target, so describing the yield as having “恢复” (recovered) overstates the result; it only partially rebounded.
质量工程师明确要求验证完成前不得关闭WO_0121，而后续维护人员说可以收尾，智能体也确认可以关闭。虽然72小时验证已通过，但对话没有说明任务关闭前已完成或解除此前的约束。
该工具调用没有对应的工具名、参数或结构化调用上下文，只给出“本班暂无新增告警记录”的结果，无法核实查询对象或班次范围。

The void-rate result identifies the lot and measurement but provides no equipment association. The agent’s claim that the defective joints were produced on REFLOW-OVEN-02-094 is not supported by the queried data.
质量工程师询问是否应将结论记入工单，代理称会记录，但对话中没有相应的工单写入工具调用或结果。随后MES只显示任务已登记，不能证明该处理记录已写入。
查询结果称预热温度调整后良率峰值为82%，仍低于85%目标；代理却称良率曾短暂“恢复”，容易与达到目标或恢复正常相混淆。
用户称配方已更新并完成首件确认、正在等待验证结果；首件查询只能确认首件尺寸和外观通过，不能核实稳定性验证状态，但代理仍据此重复了等待稳定性验证的结论，未查询所请求的验证结果。
用户要求查稳定性验证和过程能力的相关记录，代理只查询过程能力；工具返回连续5批Cpk及良率并据此判定稳定性验证通过，却没有独立的稳定性验证记录或查询。仅凭过程能力结果不能充分证实所称验证已完成。
代理表示工单可以关闭后，操作员提出的是“关闭后30天内”的回访待办；对话没有创建待办或确认挂单的动作，后续回应也未说明该待办已登记。

The yield query is made around 21:49, but its reading is timestamped 14:53; the tool message and agent then describe 68.5% as the current yield. The reading may be the latest available, but its age makes the unqualified “current” claim misleading.

The operator raises a suspected recipe/material mismatch, but the system notification only says the inspection plan is on schedule, and the maintenance engineer’s “I’ll handle it” does not clarify what action they mean or address the suspected mismatch.

The yield query is made around 12:19, while the reported measurement is timestamped 03:13; the tool and agent present the 70.2% figure as the latest/current status without noting that it is roughly nine hours old.

This session begins with “在，怎么了？” as if replying to an earlier prompt, but no such prompt appears in the dialogue. The subsequent suspected-cause remark and automatic-inspection result also have no stated request or follow-up.
S01记录ALARM_293在2026-02-27仍处于活动状态；S03却称补液后液位一度恢复、随后再次下降，而期间没有交代报警解除或补液处置的时间和结果，报警状态的演变缺失。
液位视窗显示正常，但液位传感器读数仅32%、低于下限，工具却据此判定补液处置未生效。两种读数不一致更直接指向传感器或测量异常，不能单凭读数认定补液无效。
用户要求查询补液后问题复发的明细；工具返回的数据表明液位视窗正常而传感器读数偏低，核心发现是读数不一致，但代理总结只重复液位下降，未指出这一关键矛盾或落实用户要求的明细。
S04称传感器已更换、设备恢复运行并等待验证；查询结果显示传感器更换后的液位数据时间为2026-03-08 22:19，早于本次交接所称的更换完成，时间顺序与“更换后”不符或至少未得到说明。
02:57发起的72小时查询在03:00返回“连续运行72小时”，但观测时间却是01:20，且没有说明这些数据是截至01:20的历史窗口结果。更重要的是，S04刚称设备恢复后仍待连续运行验证，S05仅隔约11天便凭该摘要批准关闭，缺少与待验证状态及验证周期相符的清晰证据。
S04明确要求验证完成前不得关闭WO_0093；S05虽有验证通过的查询结果，但代理直接批准关闭任务，没有确认或执行工单关闭状态，也未交代约束已满足的依据。
针对冷却液低液位报警，代理先查润滑压力，并称其正常后再查报警日志；润滑压力与冷却液液位故障没有直接诊断关联，作为优先排查项不合理。
两条自动化消息被标为system_tool/tool_call，却直接给出能耗同步和自动巡检结果，而非工具调用请求或工具观测；说话方/消息类型与内容不匹配。
锡膏状态查询针对回流炉设备，返回的只是设备当前使用的锡膏批次及回温记录，不能证明LOT202508-602生产时所用锡膏状态正常；而且锡膏通常在印刷工序使用，不是回流炉本身的物料。
维护工程师先询问该批次是否需要跟进，但没有得到明确答复；操作员提出传感器漂移这一初步原因后，系统仅报告本班无新增记录，后续关于是否上报的问答也未形成清晰的跟进决策。
代理承诺有新检测数据时会第一时间主动同步，但对话没有显示其具备持续监控或主动通知能力；这会造成超出查询式工具能力的承诺。
质量工程师要求验证完成前不得关闭WO_0122，但代理随后只承诺记录结论，没有说明该批次仍在待放行、尚未完成验证，也未确认会遵守不得关闭任务的约束。
S04明确规定LOT202508-602验证完成前不得关闭WO_0122；S05虽有三次复检通过的证据，但代理直接表示任务可以关闭，没有核实或说明规定的验证是否已完成。

The query says the recipe was updated during the previous shift on March 1, but the first-article record is dated March 2 at 06:17, before the 07:30 start of the day shift. That timestamp does not support the stated timing of the update and confirmation.

The engineer explicitly says not to close WO_0127 until validation is complete, but the agent later says it can be closed without any tool call or confirmation that the work order itself is eligible for closure. The capability result supports passing validation, but not necessarily satisfying the explicit closure constraint.

The MES reports the same task as newly registered and processing twice, with no intervening update or explanation. The duplicate status messages are redundant and do not reflect a clear state transition.

The request says the remaining check is inventory, but the agent says it will confirm batch association and queries that instead. It reports association correction while leaving the requested inventory confirmation pending.

Quality explicitly says WO_0128 must not be closed until verification is complete. The next scenario asks to close it based on a field check, and the agent endorses closure after an inventory result, without confirming that the required verification or quality constraint has been satisfied.

The WMS location changes from A-08-20 on 2026-04-03 to A-01-01 on 2026-04-11, but the query only reports that the current location matches WMS. Treating this as a normal check without showing a move or location history leaves the lot's relocation unexplained.

The query says the corrected batch association is awaiting inventory confirmation, and the tool reports all 12 cartons associated, but the response still describes confirmation as pending without mentioning the successful association result. The association result does not itself establish that inventory verification is complete, so this is an incomplete update rather than a direct reversal.

The quality engineer states that the lot must be verified before WO_0124 is closed and warns against reusing a failed adjustment. The agent only promises to record the conclusion; it does not acknowledge either constraint or identify the conclusion to be recorded.

The user says inventory confirmation has already established that all 12 cartons are correctly associated, but the agent queries inventory over only 72 hours and relies on that result to authorize closure. The 72-hour query window does not cover the reported verification from the prior correction, so the tool result cannot substantiate the stated historical confirmation.

The maintenance engineer says to keep a 30-day follow-up review pending, then asks what else needs attention. The agent replies only with a generic promise to monitor data and does not mention the explicit follow-up or its timing.
用户请求核实批次的具体情况；回答确认了超限和隔离状态，却没有提供工具查到的关键检测值4.8%、上限3.0%及检测时间。
锡膏状态查询以回流炉设备为目标，但返回该炉在用锡膏批次及回温记录；回温和锡膏状态通常应关联锡膏批次或供料记录，不能仅凭炉体设备直接测得。
助焊剂比重查询以回流炉为目标，但回流焊炉通常不使用或监测助焊剂比重；该指标更适用于波峰焊等助焊剂施加工序。
锡膏状态查询再次以回流炉为目标并返回炉体的在用锡膏批次及回温记录，存在设备与物料追溯对象不匹配的问题。
用户要求核查更换预热传感器和校准的相关记录，且已称返工复检合格；代理却先查链速和物料批次，再查空洞率，没有查询传感器更换或校准记录。
质量工程师明确规定LOT202512-606验证完成前不得关闭WO_0126；下一场景虽有三次复检通过的结果，但代理只复述“可以关闭”，没有说明任务已关闭或执行关闭操作。若将该回答理解为已完成关闭，就违背了先验证的约束；若仅表示具备关闭条件，则应明确这一点。
This is labeled as a system tool call, but its content is a result (“本班暂无新增告警记录”) and no preceding request or tool name is shown. The result therefore appears without a corresponding call.
这条被标记为system_tool/tool_call，却直接给出“本区域其他设备状态正常”的巡检结果，没有工具名、参数或对应的tool_observation，无法追踪其来源。
用户说重新扫描和更正已在“等盘点确认”的过程中；查询结果却称16:28已确认12箱全部关联，早于19:12的提问，但助手仍答复为“等待盘点确认”。结果显示关联查询已更正，不等同于盘点验证完成，助手应区分这两种状态。

The system inserts generic area-status and inspection-plan messages that do not address the operator’s follow-up question or connect to the maintenance engineer’s suspected label mismatch. They read like unrelated, unsolicited tool output.
助焊剂比重通常用于有液态助焊剂槽的工艺控制，不是回流焊炉的常规设备参数。将该读数直接关联到REFLOW-OVEN-02-610，缺少工艺或设备背景支撑。
Agent承诺将结论记入WO_0130处理记录，但对话中没有相应的工单写入工具调用或写入结果，无法确认所承诺的记录操作已执行。
质量工程师明确要求 LOT202512-614 验证完成前不得关闭 WO_0134，但代理在仅有返工复检合格、仍处于待放行状态时承诺任务可关闭；后续才查到放行前复检通过。
首轮空洞率检测时间为 2025-12-06 01:18，之后相隔多日仍把同一批次的返工抽检描述为预热设定调整后的结果，却没有相应返工时间或批次追溯信息；24小时查询也返回了远早于查询时间的记录，难以支撑所述时序。
12月11日仅记录预热传感器读数疑似不准、实际温度偏低且待确认，之后却出现临时上调设定并短暂改善的叙述；对传感器问题的确认、调整及其时间都没有交代。
代理把助焊剂比重作为回流炉设备级参数查询，但助焊剂通常用于焊膏或涂覆工艺，并非回流炉的常规在线参数；该数据也未说明测量对象或来源。
代理报告返工复检合格并进入待放行后，质量工程师仍强调验证完成前不得关闭任务，说明当前回复没有区分返工复检合格与批次验证完成，状态表达不清。
The user asks for alarm details, and the tool returns the trigger time and says the alarm remains active. The agent only repeats the code and category, omitting those key details.

The user asks for the relevant records, and the tool provides the vibration readings, threshold, trend, and detection time. The agent merely echoes the user's description instead of reporting the queried data.

The user asks for detailed data, and the tool provides a vibration reading of 1.1 mm/s and its detection time. The agent gives only a general recovery statement, leaving out the requested measurement.

The system notice only says the inspection plan is on schedule, but the maintenance engineer replies as though the system had spoken to them directly. No question or request for a response appears in the preceding turn.
The same inspection-plan notice is repeated without any intervening event that would explain a second notification.

The operator raises a tentative material/recipe mismatch, but the purported tool-call turn only reports that there are no new alarms and gives no investigation or action details. The maintenance engineer’s “已经安排” has no clear antecedent or specified arrangement.

The agent promises ongoing monitoring and immediate notification, but no monitoring subscription, alert setup, or other mechanism is shown. This overstates what the demonstrated tool workflow supports.

The worker asks for detailed alarm data, and the tools return the alarm time and active state, but the agent only repeats the alarm code and category. The process engineer then says they will handle it without any stated action or assignment.

The user says the sensor-mount bolts were retightened after shift handover, but the reported vibration event and handheld comparison are timestamped 09:02, before this session began at 11:55. The tool's claim that the 09:02 reading followed that retightening is chronologically inconsistent.

A vibration query reports a handheld meter reference of 1.3 mm/s as though it were measured historical telemetry, but a handheld reading is normally a manually collected spot measurement and would need a documented inspection time/source to be returned this way.

The user asks to check continuous-run verification after a sensor replacement during the previous shift, but the vibration result is a single reading from 2026-04-16 20:37, not a continuous-run verification. The agent nevertheless echoes that the machine is awaiting verification without explaining this mismatch.
The tool presents a handheld vibration-meter reading as historical query data for 2026-04-16 20:37 without identifying a recorded inspection, making the provenance of this manual measurement unclear.

A constraint says not to close WO_0137 until verification is complete, but no verification is reported in this session before the user claims it is complete. The agent then treats a 72-hour vibration summary as sufficient verification and authorizes closure without addressing the missing evidence or confirming the work-order state.

The 72-hour vibration summary is timestamped 19:30 on April 26, while the prior vibration query in the preceding session was timestamped 20:37 on April 16. These timestamps are less than 72 hours apart, so the claimed continuous 72-hour verification cannot be supported by the stated data window.

The operator specifies a concrete follow-up action—revisit the machine within 30 days after work-order closure—but the agent only promises to monitor data and notify of changes, without acknowledging or recording the scheduled follow-up.
这两条被标为 system_tool/tool_call，但内容是已完成检查后的结果陈述，而非工具调用或调用参数。工具返回结果应标为 tool_observation，或提供实际调用信息。
报警在17:59触发，而用户称接班后报警；按给定班次，17:59处于中班，且查询时间为20:59。报警记录与用户所述接班后新发报警的时间不一致，回复也未说明这一差异。
用户要求查询报警明细，但助手最终只复述了报警名称，没有给出触发时间、当前仍活跃等工具查到的关键明细。
温度查询的实测时间是04:12，远早于11:13的润滑压力读数和11:07的用户询问；却被用来描述降速后温度随后再次升高，未交代这段趋势如何与当前核查对应。
助手承诺有新检测数据会第一时间主动同步，但对话未体现任何监测或通知机制；仅能在此处响应查询的助手通常不能保证在后续数据到来时主动通知。
质量工程师明确要求验证完成前不得关闭WO_0141；之后用户仅询问能否结案，助手根据72小时验证通过回答可以关闭，但对话中没有实际关闭操作或确认关闭状态。回复把允许关闭说成已可直接结案，未核实任务状态或执行关闭。
“刚才那一批的问题”没有在当前对话中出现，且与用户提出的LOT202602-616追溯缺失问题没有明确关联，像是带入了其他场景的上下文。
这两条标为system_tool/tool_call，却直接给出巡检结果和记录检查结果，而不是工具调用内容；工具结果通常应作为tool_observation返回。
用户要求查看明细数据，但良率工具只返回检测总数和良率，助手也未提供明细或说明无法查询明细。
用户询问如何在有新数据时通知，助手承诺会在此同步，但没有说明通知机制或如何触发后续同步；对话中也没有后续新数据通知。
用户称调整发生在“这个班早些时候”，但查询结果显示关键检测时间为08:12，而对话发生在13:32，且按给定班次日历此时是白班；08:12早于白班开始时间，时间归属不一致。
用户说配方更新发生在当天这个班，但首件记录时间是前一日23:03；该记录早于1月6日01:10开始的夜班，不能佐证本班更新后的首件确认。
此前明确规定验证完成前不得关闭WO_0143，而助手后来只称任务“可以关闭”，未确认实际关闭；之后的回访要求又以“关闭后30天内”为前提，状态表述不清，无法判断是否已关闭。
用户询问结论是否要记入工单，助手承诺会记录，但对话中没有工单更新工具调用或写入结果，不能确认记录实际完成。
The two EMS sync messages appear without a preceding request or stated reason, and the second repeats the first without adding information or responding to the operator’s tentative belt diagnosis.
Both turns are labeled system_tool/tool_call, but their content is phrased as an EMS response (“返回”), which is an observation/result rather than a tool call.

The dialogue repeatedly treats standalone flux specific gravity as a routine diagnostic for a reflow oven. Reflow soldering uses solder paste; a flux-specific-gravity reading is not an evident or relevant oven measurement here.
The agent promises to record the conclusion in WO_0142, but no work-order update tool call or other record-writing action follows.

S02 opens with system notifications about records and alarms, but the operator responds as if directly prompted (“在的，您说”), and then says “交给我吧” without a clear request or handoff. The turns do not form a coherent exchange.

S01 reports that the missing traceability nodes include both receiving scan and batch association, while S03 says the label was later supplemented and only one carton still lacks batch association. The intervening correction is plausible, but the dialogue never establishes that the receiving-scan gap was also resolved.

The query says the batch association was corrected and rescanning completed during the current shift, and the agent reports that status as awaiting inventory. Yet the tool’s correction was measured at 22:18 on the previous date, before this shift began, so the stated timing and the reported evidence do not align.

Quality states that WO_0148 must not be closed before verification is complete. The next shift’s agent says it can be closed based on a passing inventory verification, but does not establish that the required verification is complete or address the constraint; the earlier status explicitly said inventory confirmation was still pending.
助焊剂比重通常是助焊剂供给/使用环节的指标，不是回流焊炉本体的测量值；而且用它作为回流焊点空洞率问题的首要排查项关联较弱。
Agent承诺将结论写入WO_0146处理记录，但对话中没有记录写入工具调用或完成确认；随后“安排上了”也未说明是否落实了这项记录。
两条记录都标为 system_tool/tool_call，但内容是巡检结果和告警查询返回值；对话中没有对应的工具调用或请求，工具交互流程缺少调用步骤。

The operator raises a suspected mismatch between the equipment parameters and a specific material lot, but the following tool-call line only reports that there are no new shift alarms, without identifying a tool or addressing the suspected mismatch. The maintenance engineer's “already arranged” response has no clear referent or stated action.

The user asks for the status of validation after the recipe update, but the agent checks only first-article inspection and then reports that stability validation is still pending. No validation-status query or result is shown, so the requested status is not actually established.

The user asks to confirm both stability validation and process-capability review, but the only query is for process capability and the returned data does not explicitly report a separate stability-validation result. The agent nevertheless asserts that both passed and that the work order can be closed.

The tool reports a minimum batch yield of 86.4% across five batches but provides no per-batch results; this supports the stated yield threshold, but not a detailed stability conclusion by itself. Treating this alone as proof of stability is under-supported.
本段以“系统检查……无新增记录”开场，但没有前置请求或检查触发；维护工程师随即问“怎么了”，也没有明确对应的发言。
工程师询问验证完成前还需要注意什么，代理只泛泛承诺关注数据，没有回应此前明确提出的任务关闭限制及不得重复失败方案等约束。

The tool reports all 12 cartons already associated after rescanning, while the agent says the corrected association is still awaiting inventory confirmation. This may distinguish association from inventory verification, but the response does not make that distinction clear.

The agent says WO_0140 can be closed after the inventory check, but an earlier explicit constraint says not to close it until verification is complete. The later maintenance turn also describes a follow-up due after closure, without any recorded closure action or clear confirmation that closure occurred.
